items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...or with Lone Johnson's approach? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, you mean musically, or?

ctx.x: Well, you mean, aside from Bunk's band? Yeah. Well, I, uh, got to know Danny Barker and Alan Nicholas, uh, while I was up there more than any other, uh, of the New Orleans musicians. Uh, played a few jobs with Nicholas and, uh, with Danny. Mm-hmm. And, uh, Pops Foster.
What do you think of their approach as compared with the approach of, say, the Joyce Lewis group, or with Lone Johnson's approach?
